Load the downstream groups' barriers into a persist schema

Source: R/lnk_downstream.R
lnk_downstream_load.Rd

Puts the barriers and barrier_overrides rows that lnk_downstream_files() lists into the persist schema cfg names (cfg$pipeline$schema, set as the run will set it), so a lnk_pipeline_run() of the target there walks downstream through the rows the provincial run's walk read. Each part is fetched and checked for size and md5 before the database is touched; every group is then replaced in one transaction, with each part's row count checked, and recorded in <schema>.log_downstream_load.

Usage

lnk_downstream_load(
  conn,
  files,
  cfg,
  replace = FALSE,
  allow_missing = FALSE,
  cache_dir = tools::R_user_dir("link", "cache")
)

Arguments

conn

DBI connection to the target database.

files

The data frame lnk_downstream_files() returns, for one target and config.

cfg

The lnk_config the target will be modelled with, its pipeline$schema set to the persist schema the run writes.

replace

Replace a dependency group's rows even when this schema built them, or holds them from no recorded load.

allow_missing

Load what the export has even when some dependencies' rows are not in it.

cache_dir

Where downloaded parts are kept.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame per dependency loaded: wsg, run_id, barriers, barrier_overrides (rows; NA for a table files did not list), config_hash, config_same.

Details

It refuses, before writing, when a dependency's rows are not in the export (skipped or not_exported, unless allow_missing), and when the schema holds rows of a dependency group that did not come from an earlier load: a build of the group here (a finished <schema>.log row), or rows of unknown origin (unless replace).

It reports, without refusing, each dependency build whose config_hash differs from cfg's bundle (the rows were built under other rules than the target will be), and each input whose identity here differs from what the dependencies were built from: CABD's and PSCIS's content md5, the observations' and modelled crossings' loader version id (attribute inputs_differ of the result, whose state is differs or not compared: an input the build recorded no identity for is named, not passed over). The target's own inputs on this machine still decide its own barriers and lifts.

See also

Other export: lnk_catalog(), lnk_db_load(), lnk_downstream_files(), lnk_scenario_export()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
conn <- lnk_db_conn(dbname = "fwapg", host = "localhost", port = 5432L,
                    user = "postgres", password = "postgres")
cfg <- lnk_config("default")
cfg$pipeline$schema <- "fresh_default"
f <- lnk_downstream_files("s3://fresh-bc/habitat/fwa/v1/manifest.json",
                          wsg = "PARS", config = "default")
lnk_downstream_load(conn, f, cfg)
} # }
